title: Keyboard Manager: Unable to select specific app for remapping shortcut
author: loganblankk
summary: Deleting an app-specific remap can leave its target-app restriction attached to a visually global replacement.

confidence.rationale: The stateful sequence strongly indicates stale target-app data.

judgment.rationale: The delete-and-recreate sequence distinguishes stale state from the autocomplete expectation.
evidence: The field is free text, not a documented autocomplete list.
A Chrome-specific Win+W remap was deleted.
The new blank-target mapping still worked only in Chrome.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.

steps: Delete it and create a blank-target remap.
Test in Chrome and Notepad before and after restart.

proposed_fixes.title: Clear target-app state when deleting a remap
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A deleted row or persisted model is reused without clearing TargetApp.
plan: Reset TargetApp and validation state on delete, clear, or global conversion.
verification: Recreate a global Win+W mapping and confirm it works outside Chrome after restart.
